evidence: Has the Validation label and modifies reindex and ActivateBestChain logic in src/validation.cpp and src/node/blockstorage.cpp.
rationale: The PR fixes an issue where reindexing after an interrupted early IBD fails to locate the assumevalid block in headers, falling back to full script verification and slowing reindex times. This addresses a real performance penalty in an uncommon salvage edge case, making review worthwhile but reasonably deferrable.
